items.summary: DisplayAvenue delivers end-to-end product shoots for brands that want clarity, speed, and ROI — powered by strategy, creative, and AI.

benefits.title: Strategy first
benefits.desc: We align product shoots with your business goals, audience, and funnel — not vanity metrics.

benefits.title: Expert execution
benefits.desc: Specialists who ship weekly, report clearly, and optimize continuously.

benefits.title: AI-accelerated delivery
benefits.desc: Our AI platform speeds research, content, QA, and reporting without losing human judgment.

benefits.title: Transparent ROI
benefits.desc: Dashboards, attribution, and monthly reviews so you always know what’s working.

process.title: Discover
process.desc: Audit current state, competitors, and opportunities across channel and funnel.

process.title: Plan
process.desc: Define goals, messaging, tech stack, timeline, and success metrics.

process.title: Build & launch
process.desc: Execute with quality checks, tracking, and staged rollouts.

process.title: Optimize & scale
process.desc: Iterate from data — improve conversion, efficiency, and growth.

faqs.q: How fast can we start Product Shoots?
faqs.a: Most engagements kick off within 5–7 business days after scope confirmation.

faqs.q: Do you work with startups and enterprises?
faqs.a: Yes. We tailor scope, SLAs, and reporting for startups, SMBs, and enterprise teams.

faqs.q: Can this integrate with our existing stack?
faqs.a: We work with Google, Meta, HubSpot, Shopify, WordPress, custom CRMs, and most modern tools.

faqs.q: Is pricing fixed or custom?
faqs.a: We offer package tiers and custom proposals based on goals, complexity, and volume.
